name: tool_search
description: Discover enabled tools via compact summaries. Omit full schemas by default (leave include_schema false) unless you truly need exact parameter shapes—schemas are token-heavy. Prefer limit 6 or fewer unless browsing many options. After matches return, call the surfaced tools by exact name; do not loop on tool_search alone.

query.description: Semantic search query describing the capability or task you want to find. Leave empty to browse available tools.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tools to return. Defaults to 6 (server cap 20). Prefer 4–6 unless you need broad browse.

tool_names.description: Optional exact tool names to inspect directly instead of doing semantic search.

include_schema.description: Defaults to false (recommended). Only set true when you must read exact parameter keys/types; each schema adds substantial context.
